How the image is scanned

The player scans the image from left to right. The colors in each section form a melody with accompaniment.

Hue sets the pitch, saturation shapes the timbre, and brightness affects volume. Black produces a low, mysterious sound. White sounds like a bright bell, and gray has a soft tone.
